cohort: 24 pregnant women in early gestation, 24 pregnant women at term, and 24 nonpregnant controls matched for age and BMI.
finding: Pregnancy leads to decreased leptin transport into the brain and resistance to the effects of leptin on target melanocortin neuropeptides, suggesting an adaptation favoring increased appetite in early gestation.
gest_age: Early pregnancy: 16.6 +/- 1.1 weeks, Term pregnancy: 39.2 +/- 0.2 weeks
